cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

pulsarchain.bridge.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

actions_reduced_root_snapshot_window_siz.description: actions_reduced_root_snapshot_window_size is the retained consensus root window.

confirmation_depth.description: confirmation_depth is the Mina finality depth used by the archive wrapper.

contract_address.description: contract_address is the Mina bridge contract address.

max_block_range.description: max_block_range is the maximum Mina height span processed by one request.

start_block_height.description: start_block_height is the first Mina block indexed by the bridge.

action_hashes.description:
action_hashes is the ordered canonical hash batch that reconstructs
the root transition for the source Cosmos block.

action_hashes_cosmos_block_height.description:
action_hashes_cosmos_block_height is the Cosmos block height where
this query batch was produced.

latest_fetched_mina_height.description:
latest_fetched_mina_height is the inclusive upper Mina cursor of the
current batch. Together with start_mina_height it defines the consumed
Mina interval (start_mina_height, latest_fetched_mina_height].

start_mina_height.description: start_mina_height is the exclusive lower Mina cursor of the current batch.

pulsarchain.keyregistry.v1.ActorType.description:
ActorType identifies the key-registry actor authorized by a signing challenge.

 - ACTOR_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: ACTOR_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is invalid for key-registry operations.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_USER: ACTOR_TYPE_USER identifies a user account key association.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_VALIDATOR: ACTOR_TYPE_VALIDATOR identifies a validator consensus key association.

pulsarchain.keyregistry.v1.KeySigningOpe.description:
KeySigningOperation identifies the key-registry state transition authorized
by a wallet field signature.

 - KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_UNSPECIFIED: KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_UNSPECIFIED is invalid for signing requests.
 - KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_REGISTER: KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_REGISTER creates the first stable-key association.
 - KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_UPDATE: KEY_SIGNING_OPERATION_UPDATE replaces an existing Mina key.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.CommitmentEn.description: CommitmentEntry is a query representation of a retained commitment.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.CommitmentRe.description: CommitmentRecord stores a validator commitment root.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.FinalProofRe.description: FinalProofResult stores an immutable finalized proof outcome.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.Params.description: Params defines the governance-controlled verification module parameters.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.ProofKey.description: ProofKey identifies a proof by absolute block height and in-block index.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.ProofRecord.description: ProofRecord stores the complete descriptor and its chain-derived identity.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.ProofStatus.description:
ProofStatus is the finalized verification outcome.

 - PROOF_STATUS_PENDING: PROOF_STATUS_PENDING is the non-finalized status.
 - PROOF_STATUS_VALID: PROOF_STATUS_VALID means valid voting power exceeded two thirds.
 - PROOF_STATUS_INVALID: PROOF_STATUS_INVALID means invalid voting power exceeded two thirds.
 - PROOF_STATUS_INCONCLUSIVE: PROOF_STATUS_INCONCLUSIVE means neither side reached threshold.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.ProofTally.description: ProofTally stores the historical consensus power behind effective votes.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.ProofType.description:
ProofType selects the verifier family. The exact statement and circuit are
bound separately by the public-input and verification-key hashes.

 - PROOF_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: PROOF_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is invalid for proof submission.
 - PROOF_TYPE_MINA_PICKLES: PROOF_TYPE_MINA_PICKLES selects Mina's Pickles proof system.
 - PROOF_TYPE_NOIR_BARRETENBERG: PROOF_TYPE_NOIR_BARRETENBERG selects Noir proofs using Barretenberg.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.QueryFinalPr.description: QueryFinalProofResultResponse contains an immutable proof result.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.QueryProofRe.description: QueryProofResponse contains either pending or finalized proof state.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.QueryProofTa.description: QueryProofTallyResponse contains a pending proof tally.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.QueryProofsB.description: QueryProofsByHeightResponse contains a page of proofs.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.Verification.description: VerificationVoteEntry is a query representation of an effective vote.

pulsarchain.verification.v1.VoteState.description:
VoteState tracks a validator's effective vote.

 - VOTE_STATE_NONE: VOTE_STATE_NONE means the validator has not voted.
 - VOTE_STATE_TRUE: VOTE_STATE_TRUE is an effective valid vote.
 - VOTE_STATE_FALSE: VOTE_STATE_FALSE is an effective invalid vote.
 - VOTE_STATE_EQUIVOCATED: VOTE_STATE_EQUIVOCATED excludes conflicting votes from the tally.
